acceptanceCriteria: Owner accepts exact first agent and editor profiles, language/server/client versions, workspace layouts, standard and Corvint-specific methods, unsupported cases and resource budgets.

Public fixture labels and separately protected held-out tasks are frozen without reading existing sealed holdouts; upstream-only, Corvint-only and combined arms are reproducible from pinned repos/tools.

Correctness, coverage, freshness, cold/warm p50/p95, memory/CPU, output/query cost and task-outcome floors are numerical and frozen against the baseline before promotion; missing measures remain NOT_RUN.
The proposed LQP-V0 contract, requirements index and evidence record are reviewed, integrated, and native completion evidence is audited.
body:
Parent V1-0477. Define accepted agent/editor support tuples, capability matrix, profile budgets, public and protected corpora, and three-arm measurable promotion floors. PR #360 is a proposed technical contract; its exploratory sample is not a distribution. This ticket owns owner acceptance and reproducible baseline evidence before later slices can claim support.

Progress 2026-09-29: draft PR #360 head 16e13f85 adds reviewed proposed LQP-V0 contract and repeatable public two-witness three-arm Go baseline. Clean head ce39fcc3 measurement: direct gopls 6/6 definitions, Core 6/6 expected paths, combined 3/6 expected relations; one witness missed in 3/3 despite 64 queries and 61 omitted rows. Harness correctly exits 1. Results and limits are in docs/build-log/2026-09-29-lsp-public-baseline.md. Focused docs/specindex checks and CEM change/check/seal passed (8 supported, 0 unknown); OCM links 0/18. Exact owner-approved profiles, protected held-out set, comparable latency/resources and task-outcome floors remain open. Ticket stays OPEN.


2026-09-29 follow-up, PR #360 head a7c2a39a: a matched direct CLI repro on the same clean source and binary with --limit 20 vs 32 kept the exact same three seeds and query digest and issued 64 queries in both runs. The 20-row external projection omitted 12 path relations and missed the expected context.go-to-provider.go definition; the 32-row projection included it. The observed gold miss is therefore the packet projection bound/order, while query-budget exhaustion is a separate observed limit. The baseline build log and PR description now make this distinction. Protected held-out, numerical floors, editor outcomes and owner acceptance remain open.

Owner scope decision 2026-09-29: initial Go/gopls agent qualification and VS Code plus Neovim editor qualification accepted in chat. Exact builds, methods, layouts, budgets, held-out custody and numerical promotion floors remain proposed or unmeasured. This decision does not accept broader languages or promotion. Continue experimental implementation and qualification.

2026-09-29 owner explicitly approved the governing LSP technical contract and its merge. PR360 merged at624e9aecbf71993d26c57b2e20837282469cb02c after all CI passed on exactheada7c2a39a6dcc7b4a7b2c8193355cfde686a0af3d. New evidence-binding branch/worktree lsp-editor-bound starts at that origin/main commit; reviewed prototype carried forward with exact source-content checks and newbase scoped gates pending. This approval accepts the technical contract, not exact qualified profiles, numerical floors, a release or world-class claim. Those decisions/qualification and native completion remain open.

2026-09-30 owner acceptance: human replied “Accept these evaluation targets and protocol” to exact /tmp/lsp-qualification-freeze-proposal.json SHA256bb5f077c9197776109301f924c6a61d40216dcebbcac02c9e1b9d9b5c2391f1b. Accepted experimental policy:20protectedtasks across3completepinnedGorepositories; exact consumer/method/domain scoringunits, microprecision>=0.95/microrecall>=0.90, paired combined tasksuccess>=bestbaseline plus at least1jointtaskgain; all abstentions/timeouts/failures remain denominator. Hard floors zero invention/stale-promotion/unauthorizedwrites/private-diagnostic-leaks/owneddescendantsurvivors,100% Coreparity and exact safety/refusal cases. Cold agent p95<=30s, editorinit<=20s, warm definition<=250ms/context<=2s; CPU<=60s/request, observed100ms simultaneous owned-group sampledRSS<=2GiB (lowerbound on truepeak, no hard containment assertion), envelope/query/record caps retained. Fixed20cold/100warm perconsumer/method/arm/root,5retainedwarmups, matched prepared offline caches and explicit process-lifecycle boundaries; procedural independent custodian freezes hidden gold/corpus digests before immutable candidate, no repair/retest on sameprotectedset. Native acceptance receipt /tmp/lsp-qualification-freeze-acceptance.json. Full typed rubric and method/refusal matrix remain in accepted proposal; exact corpus/artifact tuple freeze still NOT_PRODUCED.

Independent plan review identified LQP004 gap: manual definition-session restart cannot qualify required save/rename/branch/root stale-result rejection. Accepted policy explicitly requires actual engine invalidation and live proof, without weakening owningcontract; failed/unmeasuredmethods remainUNQUALIFIED. Corrected public-main pathbaseline6/6 eacharm and descriptive8-13s timings do not prove taskoutcomes; invalidfirstpositionrun retained. Resourcepilot8.22wall/24.54CPU/Darwinreported1.39GB maximumRSS is not matchedcoldwarm or aggregate-grouppeak proof. New exact-symbol scoringbugV1-0533 OPEN with independent malformed JSON/URI finding under firstrepair. Mainalignmentownerapproved afterworkerquiescence, existing nativeclaim refusedcapacity; no nativecompletion bypass. Ticket remainsOPEN until owncriteria/integration/gate/nativewrite pass.
title: LSP quality: accept profiles and freeze real-repository baseline
